from collections import deque

def solve(rows):
 g=[list(map(int,r.split())) for r in rows.splitlines()]
 h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); objs=[]
 for r in range(h):
  for c in range(w):
   v=g[r][c]
   if not v or (r,c) in seen: continue
   q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
   while q:
    x,y=q.pop(); cells.append((x,y))
    for a,b in ((x-1,y),(x+1,y),(x,y-1),(x,y+1)):
     if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and (a,b) not in seen and g[a][b]==v:
      seen.add((a,b)); q.append((a,b))
   objs.append((v,cells))
 # simultaneous repeated steps, only move where target is free in current frame
 while True:
  occ={(r,c):i for i,(_,cells) in enumerate(objs) for r,c in cells}
  moving=[]
  for i,(_,cells) in enumerate(objs):
   if all(c+1<w and ((r,c+1) not in occ or occ[(r,c+1)]==i) for r,c in cells): moving.append(i)
  if not moving: break
  for i in moving:
   v,cells=objs[i]; objs[i]=(v,[(r,c+1) for r,c in cells])
 out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
 for v,cells in objs:
  for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=v
 return '\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in out)
